## Changes

### Sources and extensions
- Comics now come from **sources**: small extensions the app installs, so a new or changed site no longer needs an app update. BacaKomik and VoraToon are built in; add MangaDex, MangaFire, ReiManga, WestManga and Comix from **More → Extensions**. Installed extensions show a badge when an update is available.
- Pick the source in the header of Home or Explore. Each source keeps its own bookmarks and history, and covers and comic pages show the source and language.
- MangaDex shows one source per language you turn on, for example MangaDex (EN) and MangaDex (ID).
- When a site asks for a bot check, open it in the built-in WebView and pass it; the app then reuses the check. Sites that only work in a real browser are read in the background, without any action.
- A comic whose source is not installed offers to install it.

### Library
- Make your own categories and group bookmarks by status, source or category. A comic can be in several categories.
- Pull to refresh in Bookmarks checks the comics on screen for new chapters. Stop it with **Cancel** in the notification or the stop button at the top. A comic that takes too long is skipped.
- Home's list is now called **Latest updates**.

### Migration
Open **More → Backup & sync → Migration**:
- **Migrate source:** move one comic, a selection or a whole source to another source. Each title is searched in the new source; exact matches are picked for you, and you choose the rest. Reading history and categories move along.
- **Import from Mihon / Tachiyomi:** pick a `.tachibk` backup. Bookmarks from sources BacaKomik has are imported with their categories and the chapters you read.
- **Import from Comix.to:** pick the CSV export of your Comix.to library. Titles are searched in the Comix source, one at a time.
- Imported comics load their cover and chapters when you open them or refresh, and the chapters you had read are marked read then. A series you already bookmarked from another source is not added twice.

### Fixes
- The app no longer gets stuck on the splash screen after importing a comic with a very long name; the library is repaired automatically.
- A site check passed in the WebView now takes effect right away.
